description: This file is a CMake script that monitors the state of a git repository, detects changes, and triggers reconfiguration when necessary. It defines macros and functions for checking git status, computing state hashes, and setting up build-time monitoring.

methods.name: PATH_TO_ABSOLUTE
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path.

methods.name: CHECK_REQUIRED_VARIABLE
methods.description: Checks if a required variable is set and converts it to an absolute path.

methods.name: CHECK_OPTIONAL_VARIABLE
methods.description: Checks if an optional variable is set; if not, sets it to a default value and converts to absolute path.

methods.name: RunGitCommand
methods.description: Executes a git command and sets output and exit code variables.

methods.name: GetGitState
methods.description: Retrieves current git repository state, including commit hash, author, date, and status.

methods.name: GitStateChangedAction
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when git state changes, including reconfiguring files.

methods.name: HashGitState
methods.description: Creates a hash representing the current git state for change detection.

methods.name: CheckGit
methods.description: Checks if the git repository has changed since last check.

methods.name: SetupGitMonitoring
methods.description: Sets up build system commands to monitor git state before building.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Main entry point that determines whether to check git state or set up monitoring based on build context.
